description: This Java class defines an Android Fragment named BasicManagedProfileFragment that manages and interacts with a managed profile on an Android device. It provides functionalities such as enabling/disabling specific apps (Calculator and Chrome), setting and clearing restrictions for Chrome, configuring intent forwarding, and removing (wiping) the managed profile. The fragment handles user interactions through UI buttons and switches, utilizing Android's DevicePolicyManager and PackageManager APIs to perform device management tasks.

classes.name: BasicManagedProfileFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that provides UI and logic to manage a managed profile, including app permissions, restrictions, intent forwarding, and profile removal.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes app enabled states when fragment is attached to the activity.

methods.name: isApplicationEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specified application is installed, enabled, and visible in the managed profile.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up event listeners and UI components after view creation.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button click events to set restrictions, enable/disable forwarding, send intent, or remove profile.

methods.name: onCheckedChanged
methods.description: Handles toggle switches to enable or disable specific apps within the profile.

methods.name: setAppEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables an app based on the package name within the profile via DevicePolicyManager.

methods.name: setChromeRestrictions
methods.description: Applies restrictions settings to the Chrome app to control its behavior.

methods.name: clearChromeRestrictions
methods.description: Removes restrictions from the Chrome app.

methods.name: enableForwarding
methods.description: Configures cross-profile intent forwarding to allow sharing intents between profiles.

methods.name: disableForwarding
methods.description: Clears cross-profile intent filters, disabling intent forwarding.

methods.name: sendIntent
methods.description: Sends a sample text/plain intent to demonstrate forwarding capabilities.

methods.name: removeProfile
methods.description: Wipes all data associated with the managed profile, effectively removing it.
